parsed.observations: The foreground wheat leaf has numerous tiny, scattered pale to tan specks; background leaves show yellow mottling. The specks are not clearly resolved as rust pustules. No distinct powdery colonies, necrotic blotches, or black dots within lesions are visible.
parsed.summary: Disease status is uncertain because leaf speckling and yellow mottling are visible, but diagnostic features of the allowed diseases are not clearly distinguishable.
